# threejs-skills — cloudai-x

**Repo:** https://github.com/cloudai-x/threejs-skills · **Install:** git clone; nested repo (`cloudai-threejs/<skill>/`), ten skills symlinked into the inventory 2026-08-20.
**In the set:** 10 tools — `threejs-fundamentals`, `-loaders`, `-materials`, `-lighting`, `-shaders`, `-geometry`, `-textures`, `-animation`, `-interaction`, `-postprocessing` (480–660 lines each).

## What it is

Vanilla Three.js technique references, one concern each. Not a design vendor: they build a competent
scene inside whatever page they are given.

## The contract

`collisions.md` §12: vanilla Three.js → these; React → the `core-3d-animation` plugin
(`react-three-fiber`, `babylonjs-engine`, …). They are LOOKUP-group in the catalog — discovery
proposes them for a named 3D question.

## Engage

- Discovery: a named Three.js concern ("the GLTF won't load", "add bloom") → the matching `threejs-*`.
- Direct: `/design-tools:threejs-shaders`, `/design-tools:threejs-loaders`, …
